questions.question: Where did Joshua gather Israel for the final covenant?
What famous declaration did Joshua make?
options: "The LORD your God is God in the heaven high above"
"Choose this day whom you will serve"
"Be strong and very courageous, my people"
"As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD"
questions.answer: "As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD"

questions.question: The people promised to serve the LORD, and Joshua set up a stone as a witness.
"As for me and my _____, we will serve the LORD," Joshua declared.
Joshua challenged the people, "_____ this day whom you will serve."
